bug_description.normalized: The saved 71-byte UART witness HDLC-decodes into two frames; after FCS removal, the crashing second frame payload begins `cf045a5a605af20000000000000000000010f4ff0000...`. `NcpBase::HandlePropertyInsert<SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS>` parses that frame into stack `borderRouterConfig`, reading IPv6 prefix `5a605af20000000000000000000010f4` and one-byte `prefixLength` `0xff`. `otBorderRouterAddOnMeshPrefix` forwards `borderRouterConfig.mPrefix.mPrefix.mFields.m8` and `borderRouterConfig.mPrefix.mLength` into `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix`. In the staged checkout `0f4bae97e968fbcfd997a921b29f3a81910b01eb`, `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix` uses `(aPrefixLength + 7) / 8` only inside the `Ip6::Address::PrefixMatch` guard, then sizes `Insert(...)` with `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` and calls `prefixTlv->Init(0, aPrefixLength, aPrefix)` without checking that the source prefix still fits in a 16-byte IPv6 address. `PrefixTlv::Init` therefore executes `memcpy(GetPrefix(), aPrefix, BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength))`; for `0xff`, `BitVectorBytes` is 32, so the copy reads 32 bytes from the 16-byte prefix field at the start of the 24-byte stack `borderRouterConfig`, and ASan reports a stack-buffer-overflow read in `PrefixTlv::Init`.

source.description: First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled on-mesh prefix into the stack buffer later forwarded as `aPrefix`.
source.value_from: The saved 71-byte `poc` HDLC-decodes into two frames. After FCS removal, frame 2 begins `cf045a5a605af20000000000000000000010f4ff0000...`; after the Spinel header (`0xcf`), command `SPINEL_CMD_PROP_VALUE_INSERT` (`0x04`), and property key `SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS` (`0x5a`), this read consumes the next 16 bytes `5a605af20000000000000000000010f4`. The following `ReadUint8(prefixLength)` then consumes `0xff` as the length byte.

tainted_value_origin.description: Stores the attacker-controlled `prefixLength` byte into the config field later forwarded unchanged as `aPrefixLength`.

sink.description: ASan sink. `PrefixTlv::Init` copies `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` bytes from the forwarded prefix pointer without checking that the source still fits in a 16-byte IPv6 address.
sink.note: For the witnessed `aPrefixLength = 0xff`, `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` is 32. `aPrefix` still points into `borderRouterConfig.mPrefix.mPrefix`, the first field of the 24-byte stack `borderRouterConfig` that ASan reports at `[32,56)`, so the 32-byte read crosses the stack object's end and produces the reported stack-buffer-overflow read.

root_cause.description: This staged helper's only prefix-length gate uses the rounded-up byte count only inside `PrefixMatch`; it never separately checks that `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` fits in `sizeof(Ip6::Address)` before sizing the TLV and copying from `aPrefix`.
root_cause.note: In `Ip6::Address::PrefixMatch`, any `aMaxLength > sizeof(Address)` is clamped back to 16 (`ip6_address.cpp:211-214`), so the witnessed `aPrefixLength = 0xff` is not rejected here even though the later copy size becomes 32.

parser_admitted.description: After `CommandHandler_PROP_VALUE_update` reads property key `0x5a`, `FindInsertPropertyHandler` resolves it to `HandlePropertyInsert<SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS>`, and `HandleCommandPropertyInsertRemove` invokes that handler instead of rejecting the frame.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness copies the saved 71-byte witness into a UART buffer and feeds it to `otPlatUartReceived`, entering OpenThread's NCP UART receive path.
The UART byte stream is HDLC-decoded into two frames. The crashing second frame passes FCS handling, its FCS bytes are removed, and the payload is delivered to `NcpUart::HandleFrame`.
Spinel parsing reads property key 90 (`SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS`) from a `PROP_VALUE_INSERT` command and dispatches to the on-mesh-prefix insert handler.
The handler reads a 16-byte IPv6 prefix and an oversized one-byte prefix length (`0xff`) into stack `borderRouterConfig`, then forwards that stack object to `otBorderRouterAddOnMeshPrefix`.

The staged helper uses `(aPrefixLength + 7) / 8` only in the mesh-local-prefix guard, then reserves destination TLV space with `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` and calls `prefixTlv->Init(...)` without checking that the source prefix still fits in 16 bytes.

Inside `PrefixTlv::Init`, the same unchecked length is converted to a 32-byte copy size and `memcpy(GetPrefix(), aPrefix, BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength))` reads past the 24-byte stack `borderRouterConfig`, producing the ASan stack-buffer-overflow read.

fine_trace.note: Copies 16 attacker-controlled bytes from the decoded Spinel value into `borderRouterConfig.mPrefix.mPrefix`, the stack-resident IPv6 prefix buffer later passed as `aPrefix`.
Reads the next byte of the same property value as `prefixLength`; in the saved witness this byte is `0xff`.
Stores the attacker-controlled `0xff` into the parsed config field that will later be forwarded as `aPrefixLength`.

Forwards the stack prefix buffer and the same unchecked `0xff` length into `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix`. Because `aConfig` still points to local `borderRouterConfig`, the forwarded `aPrefix` pointer aliases that stack object's first field.
The staged helper rounds the attacker-controlled bit length up to a byte count only inside the mesh-local-prefix comparison. For the witnessed `aPrefixLength = 0xff`, this expression evaluates to 32.

This is the only prefix-length gate before the copy. `Ip6::Address::PrefixMatch` clamps any `aMaxLength > sizeof(Address)` back to 16 (`ip6_address.cpp:211-214`), so the witness survives this predicate and no separate `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength) <= sizeof(Ip6::Address)` check stops the later copy.

fine_trace.code: prefixTlv = reinterpret_cast<PrefixTlv *>(mTlvs + mLength); Insert(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(prefixTlv), sizeof(PrefixTlv) + BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength) + sizeof(BorderRouterTlv) + sizeof(BorderRouterEntry));
fine_trace.note: Chooses the destination TLV start at `mTlvs + mLength` and reserves space as if `BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength)` bytes of prefix will be stored. With `aPrefixLength = 0xff`, that reservation includes 32 bytes for prefix data; it is a destination-size calculation, not a validation of the 16-byte source buffer.
Passes the destination TLV pointer, the aliased stack source pointer, and the original unchecked length straight into `PrefixTlv::Init`.

Inside the callee, the same unchecked prefix length is converted again into the memcpy size. The macro in `encoding.hpp:79` computes `((x) + (CHAR_BIT - 1)) / CHAR_BIT`, so `aPrefixLength = 0xff` becomes 32.

ASan sink. The copy reads 32 bytes from `aPrefix`, but `aPrefix` still points to the 16-byte `borderRouterConfig.mPrefix.mPrefix` field at the start of the 24-byte stack object reported by ASan (`[32,56)` for `borderRouterConfig`). The 32-byte read therefore runs past the stack object and triggers the reported stack-buffer-overflow read.

allocation_context.note: ASan identifies the overflowing source object as local stack `otBorderRouterConfig borderRouterConfig;`, occupying `[32,56)` in this frame. In `include/openthread/netdata.h`, `otBorderRouterConfig` begins with `otIp6Prefix mPrefix`, and `otIp6Prefix` is a packed 16-byte address plus one-byte length (`include/openthread/ip6.h:87-91`), so `aConfig->mPrefix.mPrefix.mFields.m8` points at the start of that 24-byte stack object.

cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes. The saved ASan trace and all source/root-cause/sink anchors line up with the staged checkout `0f4bae97e968fbcfd997a921b29f3a81910b01eb`: `HandlePropertyInsert<SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS>` at `ncp_base_mtd.cpp:773/774/778/788`, `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix` at `network_data_local.cpp:60-69`, and `PrefixTlv::Init` at `network_data_tlvs.hpp:332`. The metadata issue record names later vulnerable commit `4bc819c307999cea3ccdc297f525edf624d0883e`, but that commit is treated here only as issue provenance; every trace location in this GT is taken from the staged source tree that produced the saved crash.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The fix commit adds an explicit `prefixLengthBytes <= sizeof(Ip6::Address)` check before the `PrefixMatch` guard in `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix` (and similarly in `AddHasRoutePrefix`), preventing the witnessed `prefixLength = 0xff` case from reaching `Insert(...)` or `prefixTlv->Init(...)`.

poc.trigger: The saved 71-byte `poc` is a UART HDLC stream. Its second frame HDLC-decodes, after FCS removal, to a Spinel `PROP_VALUE_INSERT` for `SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS` whose value begins with prefix `5a605af20000000000000000000010f4`, `prefixLength` `0xff`, `stable` `0x00`, and `flags` `0x00`. Parsing that frame makes `Local::AddOnMeshPrefix` call `PrefixTlv::Init`, which copies 32 bytes from the 16-byte stack prefix buffer and produces the saved ASan stack-buffer-overflow read.

format.name: OpenThread NCP UART HDLC/Spinel frame stream
format.contract: A UART byte stream whose second HDLC frame, after unescaping and FCS removal, begins `cf045a5a605af20000000000000000000010f4ff0000`. That frame must represent Spinel header `0xcf`, command `SPINEL_CMD_PROP_VALUE_INSERT` (`0x04`), property key `SPINEL_PROP_THREAD_ON_MESH_NETS` (`0x5a`), 16-byte prefix `5a605af20000000000000000000010f4`, `prefixLength = 0xff`, `stable = 0x00`, and `flags = 0x00`; on the witnessed path this makes `PrefixTlv::Init` execute `memcpy(..., BitVectorBytes(0xff))`, i.e. a 32-byte read from the parsed 16-byte prefix buffer.
